name: Willoughby
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Willoughby, OH 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Willoughby, Ohio for 2026: the Holiday Lighting Ceremony, Santa House at Wes Point Park and nearby Eastlake's Christmas Market and Tree Lighting.
lede: Willoughby lights up downtown with an annual Holiday Lighting Celebration and gives Santa his own house in Wes Point Park for three weeks in December, with Eastlake's tree lighting and Christmas Market the weekend before.
celebrates: The City of Willoughby's events calendar lists a Holiday Lighting Celebration in downtown Willoughby, with local entertainment, Santa and Mrs. Claus on stage after the lights go on, and a Live Nativity sponsored by Willoughby United Methodist Church. Willoughby Parks and Recreation then opens Santa House at Wes Point Park, with evening hours on Thursdays and Fridays and afternoon hours on Saturdays and Sundays, and collects non-perishable food for the church's food pantry. Both events are on the city's own calendar. Next door, the City of Eastlake holds an indoor Christmas Market at City Hall on November 29, followed by a tree lighting and an evening with Santa.
lastyear: The Lake County visitors bureau's 2025 holiday preview listed the Willoughby Annual Holiday Lighting for December 4, 2025 as part of the downtown Willoughby tree lighting season. For 2026 the city's calendar moves the ceremony to Thursday, December 3 at 7 pm, with the lights going on at about 7:35 pm after the last performance.
facts: The city's calendar says downtown Willoughby is abbreviated as DTW when it announces the lights, and the Lions Holiday Auction that follows the lighting benefits the Lions Eye Care Program and community service projects. Santa House has its own listing for each open day, and the city gives Wes Point Park's address as 4232 River Street.
trains: The Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad runs its North Pole Adventure from Rockside Station in Independence from November 13 to December 22, 2026, with 5:00 pm and 7:55 pm departures, a 90 minute ride and tickets listed at $60 to $110 per person, according to the railroad. Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland says its Holiday Ice and Lights Festival includes a North Pole Train Display from the Northern Ohio Garden Railroad Society. Neither is in Willoughby, but both are within the Cleveland area families already travel for Christmas.
train_links: The railroad that runs the North Pole Adventure Christmas train from Rockside Station in Independence.
traditions: Downtown Willoughby is lit after local performers, with Santa and Mrs. Claus on stage.
Willoughby United Methodist Church sponsors a Live Nativity on lighting night.
Santa visits at his house in Wes Point Park on Thursdays through Sundays.
An annual auction at City Hall benefits the Lions Eye Care Program.
Eastlake Christmas Market and Tree Lighting
An indoor market at Eastlake City Hall, then the tree lighting and Santa on November 29.
kidfact: Santa has a whole house in Wes Point Park in Willoughby, and families are asked to bring non-perishable food for the church pantry.
faq: When is the Willoughby Holiday Lighting Ceremony?
The City of Willoughby lists it for Thursday, December 3, 2026, at 7 pm in downtown Willoughby, with the lights going on at about 7:35 pm after the last performance.
Where can kids meet Santa in Willoughby?
Santa and Mrs. Claus greet children on stage after the lighting, and Santa House at Wes Point Park is open December 4 to 20 on Thursdays through Sundays.
A display of the Nativity story. In Willoughby the Live Nativity is sponsored by Willoughby United Methodist Church and runs from 6 pm to 8 pm on lighting night, according to the city.
The city's venue listing gives the address as 4232 River Street, Willoughby, Ohio 44094.
When is the Eastlake tree lighting?
Sunday, November 29, 2026, from 6 pm to 6:30 pm at Eastlake City Hall, 35150 Lakeshore Blvd, after an indoor Christmas Market from 2 pm to 6 pm.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Willoughby for 2026, and here is what he found: 4 family events, 1 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Wickliffe Holiday Tree Lighting at Coulby Mansion) through December 20 (Santa House at Wes Point Park), with the Christmas Market and Tree Lighting in Eastlake (November 29) and the Holiday Lighting Ceremony (December 3) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Willoughby

  • 4 Christmas events for kids in Willoughby and nearby Eastlake and Wickliffe
  • 1 free event: the Wickliffe Holiday Tree Lighting, with free hot chocolate
  • Meet Santa: Wickliffe tree lighting (November 28), Evening with Santa after the Eastlake tree lighting (November 29), Santa and Mrs. Claus at the Holiday Lighting Ceremony (December 3) and Santa House at Wes Point Park (December 4 to 20)
  • Tree lightings: Wickliffe (November 28), Eastlake (November 29) and downtown Willoughby (December 3), with horse-drawn carriage rides in Wickliffe
  • Trains: none in town; the nearest are the North Pole Adventure on the Cuyahoga Valley Scenic Railroad from Rockside Station in Independence and the North Pole Train Display at Lake Metroparks Farmpark in Kirtland
  • Season: November 28 to December 20
